Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL213 (Beta-1 adrenergic receptor). Filter to exact measurements (standard_relation equals) with non-null pChEMBL values. Require target type SINGLE PROTEIN and tax_id 9606. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
